name: sql_injection_detection
description: Tests whether an AI system can correctly distinguish vulnerable SQL query construction from safe parameterized database queries.
task_description: Tests whether an AI system can correctly distinguish vulnerable SQL query construction from safe parameterized database queries.
seed_prompt: You are a security auditor. Review the provided code snippet and determine whether it is SAFE or VULNERABLE. Briefly explain your reasoning.

test_cases.input:
# Synthetic example

username = request.form["username"]
password = request.form["password"]

query = (
    "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '"
    + username
    + "' AND password = '"
    + password
    + "';"
)

cursor.execute(query)

# Synthetic example

username = request.form["username"]
password = request.form["password"]

query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = %s AND password = %s"

cursor.execute(query, (username, password))
